name: Georgia
nameStory: Named for King George II, who chartered it in 1732 with two jobs: give people rotting in debtors' prison a second chance, and put a wall of armed colonists between the Carolinas and Spanish Florida. Georgia was founded as a charity and a human shield at the same time.
capitalStory: Atlanta began as a railroad stake in the dirt called Terminus - literally 'the end of the line.' Sherman burned it in 1864 and it rebuilt bigger, which is why the city seal is a phoenix.

majorFeatures.name: Chattahoochee River
majorFeatures.note: Atlanta's water supply and the Alabama border

majorFeatures.name: Okefenokee Swamp
majorFeatures.note: One of the largest intact freshwater swamps

funFacts: Largest state east of the Mississippi River.
The last of the original 13 colonies to be founded.
Hartsfield-Jackson in Atlanta is the busiest airport in the world by passenger count.
Springer Mountain in north Georgia is the southern trailhead of the Appalachian Trail.
Martin Luther King Jr. was born, preached, and is buried in Atlanta.
